before.requirement: Unpacking an array element with i rejects a non-integer value.
before.reason: The array path delegates element validation to its selected format. The harness selects [o!], so a string element reaches o instead of i.

after.requirement: Unpacking an array element with i rejects a non-integer value.
after.reason: The integer check remains available, but the harness still selects [o!] for array elements.

claims.reason: The same fixed [o!] format prevents the array element from reaching i on both source versions.
